title: ComfyUI H3 context cross-language structural surface
description: Deterministic, content-free record naming, for every frozen cross-language wire, the single Python authority that produces it and the exact key set it produces. Key names only: the record carries no value, prompt, media locator, credential or private path, and it grants no permission to accept an unknown key.

shapes.description: Sorted by export_name, which is unique: a wire with two authorities, or an authority claimed by two exports, fails generation rather than appearing twice here.

wire_key.description: A snake_case key as it appears on the wire. Constrained so that a value, a path or a locator cannot be recorded here even by accident.

export_name.description: The lowerCamelCase name the generated TypeScript module exports for this key set.

module_path.description: The repository-relative Python module whose to_wire produces the wire. Relative by construction, so the record never names an absolute or user-specific path.

required_keys.description: Every key the authority always emits, sorted. A to_wire whose key set cannot be resolved to literals is unresolved and stops generation, so a partial key set never reaches this record.

optional_keys.description: Keys the authority emits conditionally. Recorded separately because a closed-shape check that demanded them would reject a wire the producer may legitimately emit without them.
